chunks: So remember Allah, O people, regarding what He has entrusted to you from His Book, and what He has deposited with you from His rights,
for indeed Allah, Exalted is He, did not create you in vain, nor leave you aimless, nor leave you in ignorance and blindness,
He has named your traces, known your deeds, and recorded your terms of life,
and sent down to you, "sent down to you the Book as an explanation" (for all things),
and made His Prophet live among you for long periods, until He completed for him and for you, from what He sent down of His Book, His religion which He was pleased with for Himself,
and conveyed to you through his tongue what He loves of deeds and what He dislikes, His prohibitions and His commands,
so He presented to you the excuse, established the proof against you, put forward to you the warning, and alerted you before the face of severe punishment.
ai.seo_question: What are the key signs that Allah did not create humans in vain according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) frames the Quran and Prophethood as the complete divine evidence (hujjah) that removes any claim of ignorance, a concept central to Shia theology regarding the necessity of guidance. This passage underscores the transition from the era of the Prophet to the era of the Imams, where the 'rights' (huquq) of God are preserved through the continuation of divine instruction. It serves as a theological foundation for accountability, asserting that God’s purposeful creation is validated by the clarity of the revealed Book and the finality of the Prophet's message.

en.sayed-ali-raza: So remember Allāh, O people, about what He has asked you in His Book to take care of, and about His rights that He has entrusted to you.
Verily, Allāh has not created you in vain nor left you unbridled nor let you alone in ignorance and gloom.
He has defined what you should leave behind, taught you your acts, ordained your death,
sent down to you, “the Book (Qur’ān) explaining everything” (Qur’ān, 16:89)
and made His Prophet live among you for long time till He completed for him and for you the message sent through the Qur’ān namely the religion liked by Him,
and clarified through him His good acts and evil acts. His prohibitions and His commands.
He placed before you His arguments and exhausted his excuses upon you. He put forth to you His promises and warned you of severe retribution.
